restricciones.definicion: FOREIGN KEY (cerrada_por) REFERENCES usuarios(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (((((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['atendida'::character varying, 'descartada'::character varying])::text[])) AND (cerrada_en IS NOT NULL) AND (cerrada_por IS NOT NULL)) OR (((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pendiente'::character varying, 'en_atencion'::character varying])::text[])) AND (cerrada_en IS NULL) AND (cerrada_por IS NULL))))
CHECK (((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pendiente'::character varying, 'en_atencion'::character varying, 'atendida'::character varying, 'descartada'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((finalizado_en IS NULL) OR ((iniciado_en IS NOT NULL) AND (finalizado_en >= iniciado_en))))
CHECK ((((estado)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['exitoso'::character varying, 'fallido'::character varying])::text[])) OR (finalizado_en IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK (((((estado_operacional)::text = 'no_evaluable'::text) AND (disponibilidad_pct IS NULL)) OR (((estado_operacional)::text <> 'no_evaluable'::text) AND (disponibilidad_pct IS NOT NULL) AND (area_evaluable_px > 0))))
